dat <- read.csv(here::here("data",

# Background  

In July of 2023, the then-developing Mississippi Sound Estuary Program sent out a survey to determine where its stakeholders wanted new monitoring stations to be located. This survey used ArcGIS Survey123 and allowed respondents to place a point on the map representing the location of a desired station. Four separate surveys allowed the identification of top priority and lower priority locations. Additional fields allowed respondents to identify which parameters they would like to see monitored at the location and why.  



# Map  

Points on the map below were identified as locations where a monitoring station would be beneficial. Top priority stations are dark green (Priority: 1), with lighter green to yellow points representing lower priorities.  

**Note**: this map does *not* include existing monitoring stations. For stations with data as of the survey in 2023, see [this map](https://arcg.is/0u4HL0).  

Click on a point to see the suggested water quality and other parameters suggested to be monitored at this station.  

```{r}
# set up the popup tables
popups <- popupTable(dat, 
                     zcol = c("Priority", "WQParams", "OtherParams"), 
                     row.numbers = FALSE, 
                     feature.id = FALSE)

# style block: zebra stripes + label column top-aligned (though this doesn't really work; the zebra stripes are doing the heavy lifting)
style_tag <- '
<style>
table tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: #f2f2f2; }
table td:nth-child(1) { vertical-align: top; font-weight: bold; padding-right: 8px; }
</style>'

popups <- paste0(style_tag, popups)

# wrap the text within the values column
popups <- gsub(
  '<td',
  '<td style="word-wrap:break-word; max-width:250px;"',
  popups
)

# set height for the whole table
popups <- paste0(
  '<div style="max-height:250px; overflow-y:auto;">',
  popups,
  '</div>'
)
```

```{r}
# make the map
mapview_hydro(dat, 
              map.types = c("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas", "Esri.WorldTopoMap",
                            "Esri.OceanBasemap", "OpenStreetMap"),
              zcol = "Priority",
              col.regions = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(4, "YlGn")),
              layer.name = "Priority",
              popup = popups)

```
